pose_input: saved MoveNet MultiPose Lightning 512-input run-01, no new inference
development_selection: On earlier same-video source labels, beta 0.8 obtained 14/18 old holdout, 14/17 follow-up and 11/15 motion probe. Beta was selected from 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.8 and 1.0 before opening reserve scores. These development figures are not independent verification.
candidate_rule: Main score = 0.20*existing center + 0.35*existing bbox scale + 0.20*(existing static pose-energy/300) + 0.80*min(0.5, motion). Motion is median normalized keypoint displacement against frame index minus 20 after best previous bbox IoU >= 0.10, requiring at least five paired keypoints with confidence > 0.30. Missing motion contributes zero. Existing MainSelector switch thresholds/streak and bbox tracking stay fixed. Group flag is computed with existing 0.45-center score, independent of candidate main score, so the saved 512 group decision should be reproduced.
reserve_metric: At 20 source-only strict solo frames, count selected bbox containing approximate lead torso point, and report raw detection, all five person strata, group flag on four group and 20 solo frames, source-frame continuity and raw segment length separately.
promotion_gate: Reserve total must exceed the saved 512 baseline 8/20 and the static 0.20 candidate 11/20; blue P4 must be at least 2/4; green P1, red P3 and lavender P5 must not fall below their saved 512 baseline 3/4, 3/4, 2/4; group flags must match saved 512 because the group path is intentionally fixed. Even if this gate passes, no product replacement or clip-quality claim follows without temporal/identity/export checks.
limits: One source, nearby frames, one reviewer aware of earlier failures, approximate torso points. This can nominate a same-video candidate only; it cannot estimate other-video accuracy.
